item.title: Braves clinch postseason berth with three two-run homers
item.description: Atlanta secured a playoff spot by beating Houston 6-2 behind two-run homers from Michael Harris II, Ronald Acuña Jr. and Matt Olson. Tyler Mahle supplied a strong start, and the Braves cut their magic number for the NL East title to three.

item.title: U.S. and Czech Republic split opening Davis Cup singles
item.description: The United States ended the first day of its Davis Cup qualifier in Prague tied 1-1 with the Czech Republic. Learner Tien beat Jakub Mensik before Jiri Lehecka defeated U.S. Open finalist Ben Shelton in straight sets, leaving Saturday's doubles and reverse singles to decide the tie.

item.title: England recalls Alexander-Arnold and Palmer for Nations League
item.description: Thomas Tuchel recalled Trent Alexander-Arnold and Cole Palmer among 10 changes to England's first squad since the World Cup. England opens Nations League play against world champion Spain at Wembley on September 26 as Tuchel begins building toward a home Euro 2028.

item.title: Dodgers clinch 13th NL West title in 14 seasons
item.description: The Dodgers beat Cincinnati 8-2 to secure their fifth straight division crown and 13th NL West title in 14 years. Kyle Tucker went 4-for-5 with a homer, two doubles and three RBIs as Los Angeles improved to 93-60 and kept its postseason push rolling.

item.title: Pochettino turns to youth for U.S. men's friendlies
item.description: U.S. coach Mauricio Pochettino named a 28-man roster with 13 uncapped players for friendlies against Peru, Chile, Mexico and Canada, beginning the next World Cup cycle with a sharp turn toward youth. The group includes 16-year-old Cavan Sullivan, while Christian Pulisic and Folarin Balogun were left out.

item.title: WTA Finals will move to Charlotte in 2027
item.description: The season-ending WTA Finals will move to Charlotte's Spectrum Center in 2027 for at least three years. The tour plans to operate the event directly and pair it with a fan festival, aiming to turn its showcase for the top eight singles players and doubles teams into a signature women's sports event.

item.title: Messi scores his 100th Inter Miami goal in cup victory
item.description: Lionel Messi scored his 100th goal for Inter Miami in his 115th appearance, helping the club beat Cruz Azul 2-0 for the Campeones Cup. The 39-year-old has now helped Miami win four trophies since arriving in 2023; Casemiro added the late clincher.

item.title: Clearlake takes full control of Chelsea as Boehly exits
item.description: Clearlake Capital is buying the minority stakes held by Todd Boehly and Mark Walter, ending the ownership partnership that acquired Chelsea in 2022. Boehly will step down as chairman while Clearlake assumes full control of the Premier League club; Chelsea says daily operations and strategy will continue unchanged.

item.title: Guardians move alone atop the AL Central
item.description: Cleveland took sole possession of first place in the AL Central with a 6-3 victory over the White Sox, powered by rookie Petey Halpin's three-run homer. Elsewhere in a tightening pennant race, Cincinnati delayed the Dodgers' division clincher and Texas pulled even atop the AL West.

item.title: Leagues and player unions seek lifetime betting bans for harassers
item.description: The NFL, MLB, NBA, NHL and MLS joined their player associations in asking betting regulators in 35 states and Washington to permanently bar bettors who threaten or harass players, coaches, officials or their families. Only four states currently have such rules.

item.title: Sweeping college sports bill clears a key Senate hurdle
item.description: The Senate voted 74-24 to advance a bipartisan overhaul of college sports. The bill would regulate athlete compensation, transfers and eligibility, cap revenue sharing at 22% and permit pooled television rights. Supporters call it overdue national order; critics say it would restrict athletes.

item.title: Messi called back for an Argentina farewell match
item.description: Lionel Messi has been summoned for a ceremonial return to Argentina's squad after retiring from international soccer last month. The 39-year-old is expected to receive a farewell in an Oct. 6 friendly against Benin at Buenos Aires' Monumental Stadium.

item.title: Kenneth Walker powers Chiefs past Broncos in Kansas City debut
item.description: Kenneth Walker III ran 23 times for 173 yards and two touchdowns in his Chiefs debut, carrying Kansas City to a 31-10 win over Denver. Patrick Mahomes added two touchdown passes and a rushing score in his return from knee surgery as the Chiefs ended a three-game skid against the Broncos.

item.title: Kawhi Leonard returns to Toronto as Raptors-Clippers trade closes
item.description: Kawhi Leonard is headed back to the franchise he led to the 2019 NBA title. Toronto sent Brandon Ingram, Gradey Dick, two first-round picks, two second-rounders and a pick swap to the Clippers after the delayed deal cleared league review.

item.title: Judge homers as Yankees clinch record 61st postseason berth
item.description: Aaron Judge hit a three-run homer, his first since returning from a fractured rib that cost him more than three months, as New York beat Minnesota 8-3. The Yankees secured their ninth playoff appearance in 10 seasons and a major league-record 61st postseason berth.
